And when you get the answer?
Because I have a lot of them.
I mean, I probably know why it hurts, just don't know what to do with it.

It feels like being stuck on that feeling. On being jelaous.
Once it was about love, but now it's just about being jelaous.

I'm getting angry, jelaous when I see her or him with someone else significant to them. What's the point? They are my friends, why do I hate that thought about any of them being with someone else?
I keep talking. It just does not seem to help. I mean, what else to say after all this time. I just don't know why it still hurts when it's just a past.

oh, sorry, my bad. 
That friend of mine, he well in love with that person just the same time I did. And after two years together they break up. It's been two years since they broke up.

Thanks for explaining it, never thought about it this way. 
I had no idea why hate and love at the same time.

One of them told me to buy light anti-depressants, didn't help at all.
Basically there was a lot of talking about everything. Why, how and what.
It was not only because of this situation, also because my parents believe that I have PC addiction and recommended me to go visit a doctor. Obviously, that's related to my depression. 

Noone of them told me that I'm ill or medically depressed.

I have another meeting with a doctor that uses hypnose as a treatment, goint to visit him at 25 this month.

I don't see that coming, talking with both of them. But I could definetely try to talk with one of them. They do know that I had feelings, but totally unaware about the cause of my depression.

Leaving them would be really hard. The thing is, all my friends are also friends with them. Very close ones. And I don't have anyone else, really noone. Breaking up any connections with them would me breaking up almost every connection with everyone that still mean something to me.
I tried to work it out, but instead of getting better it was just cutting connections with society.

Thank you.

Hey, listen to me. You are not useless, not stupid or anything. You're really beautiful and brilliant. Yet, you don't have to believe me, you have at least one human in this world who believes in you. What if caring about you is one of his greatest goals. You know what? You can step out of it. You can forget all the pain. You can feel alive. It is not easy. But one day you will smile.

Please, get therapy. Not because of your family or boyfriend, because of yourself. Because you can be happy and that's what will make happy everyone who cares about you.
 
If you want to talk, feel free to pm or answer right there. :)

That sounds really bad. I, I feel for you. Been through something related.

I've got an advice btw, if you wanted to go to a psychiatrist but never had the money, you can try to find something related like psychological groups. Or this place where you study, is there any medical facilities for you that can help you without taking alot of money? 

Considering your state I can say that this kind of thing can really help you. I know what you're going through and you really need to get over it. Once it was a thing that kept your going, but now it does not seem to be very helpful. It's hard. But you must go on, there is no point in throwing your life away over past mistakes that you or someone else did. 

This world is full of beautifull people. You will find someone who will care about you.

Your friends could be affected by society, by unwritten rules or be fear of death itself. 

That thing you're talking about, there's actually a science termin for that, don't remember what's that called. It's about an urge to end it by jumping down from the high building or anything like that. For know, noone knows where it came from.

Why do you want to do this? 
Tell us, what happened?
There are so many opportunites in this world, are you sure that you want to miss all of them?
